findings: Coinbase Q3 2026 10-Q reports $1.2995B crypto assets held as collateral, $1.009297B recognized lending collateral including $997.557M crypto and $11.740M fiat/payment stablecoins, and $301.943M recognized derivatives collateral (BTC/ETH only).
Coinbase separately reports $3.284562B customer collateral not recognized as an asset or obligation to return. It must not be treated as Coinbase proprietary capital or a balance-sheet asset.

Coinbase's loan collateral requirements range 100%-250% of loan fair value; derivatives collateral requirements are at least 100% of notional. No XRP collateral is separately named. The aggregate 'other crypto' lending collateral line is $9.903M; whether it includes XRP is unknown.

Circle's October 16 blog claims $36T H1 USDC onchain volume, $315B mint/redemption, $819M distribution/transaction costs and 77% June stablecoin transaction-volume share. Visa's adjusted-volume methodology filters bots and other inorganic activity; a July 6 report citing Visa/Allium gives $8.82T H1 adjusted total and 67% USDC June share/70% H1. These definitions are not reconciled.

Circle Q2 10-Q shows $655.3M H1 Coinbase distribution costs and $815.816M H1 distribution-and-transaction costs. The ratio is approximately 80.3%, but the denominator includes transaction costs and is not a pure partner-payout pool.

Coinbase Q3 10-Q reports $306.905M stablecoin revenue (-5.4% YoY), $904.487M nine-month stablecoin revenue, and USDC rewards expense $129.245M Q3/$361.780M nine months. It attributes +$84.6M to higher average USDC balances and -$52.8M to lower average rates.

Fresh XRP derivatives snapshot at 2026-10-30 08:25 UTC: $1.2553, -2.86% 24h, $1.85B OI (-6.21%), funding -0.0055%/8h, at least $32.47M liquidations ($30.34M longs), 78.5% long accounts. Venue funding is divergent.

ETF flow sources disagree because of fund universes and settlement completeness: Alpha Finance reports +$8.4M on Oct29 across five funds; XRP Insights has Oct29 provisional and Oct26-28 -2.96M XRP across six spot funds plus BITW.
corrections: No XRP collateral use is established by Coinbase's Q3 10-Q. The derivatives collateral table names BTC and ETH; the lending table has $9.903M total 'other crypto' without token breakdown.
Unrecognized customer collateral is not Coinbase-owned capital and must not be added to recognized collateral or balance-sheet assets.

Circle's 77% June transaction-volume share is a company-reported claim with no comparable methodology in the blog; Visa's adjusted 67% June figure is a different metric. Neither is a direct XRP demand measure.
